chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام: When boys are brought, teach us the cutting of their fingers—from where are they cut? He said: “From the joint, the joint of the fingers.”

key_terms.أَنَامِلِهِمْ: their fingers; the body part mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الصِّبْيَانُ: boys; young persons referred to in the legal question
key_terms.الْمَفْصِلِ: the joint; the exact point of cutting
key_terms.قَطْعَ: cutting; the prescribed act being asked about
key_terms.مَفْصِلِ الْأَنَامِلِ: the joint of the fingers; clarification of the location intended

ai.seo_question: From where are the fingers cut according to the hadith of Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام in the hadd of theft?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Abī Ibrāhīm عليه السلام regarding the place from which the fingers are to be cut in the case mentioned. It specifies that the cutting is to be done at the joint of the fingers, making the ruling precise in its legal application.
